verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer's docs explicitly claim it can run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel and collect the results into structured output, which is a direct bulk-operation capability. Its sandboxed Linux VM with Python/Node and support for CSV/JSON/Excel/PDF/media processing implies scripted batch processing of many files. missing for 10: documented bulk operations beyond web browsing (e.g. batch updates across connected services like Jira, Linear or Gmail), stated limits or scale on parallelism beyond "dozens", and independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel bulk runs.
